location.venue_or_area: Summers Park, grounds of the Mullumbimby Museum

audience.psychographics: Local families and visitors; billed as 'a buzzing little family festival' with local artisans, up-cycled and retro stalls, eco-products, healing crystals, massage, live music buskers and food. Locally made products get stall priority.

add_sources.note: Home page: 'the original Mullumbimby Community Market in the picturesque Summers Park'; 'Established in 1989'; '3rd Saturday of every month from 8am-2pm'. IG bio: 'A Monthly Community Gathering At The Mullumbimby Museum'.
Home page: 'Come to our next great community market on Saturday 17 Oct 2026!'.
Contact page lists mullumbimbymarket@gmail.com and 0494 610 454 (stallholder contact); booking page says to email the Market Manager at the same address.
Home page description of the market and stall mix.
